10k.note: Lead therapeutic candidate is gedatolisib, a pan-PI3K (alpha/beta/gamma/delta) and mTORC1/2 kinase inhibitor of the PAM pathway. Phase 3 VIKTORIA-1 in HR+/HER2- ABC has read out (PIK3CA WT cohort meeting PFS endpoint). NDA initiated under FDA Real-Time Oncology Review program in August 2025. Second Phase 3 (VIKTORIA-2) and Phase 1b/2 prostate study (CELC-G-201) ongoing. CELsignia diagnostic platform is also commercialized but not a drug asset.

website.note: Pipeline page (https://www.celcuity.com/pipeline) returns 404; pipeline content extracted from corporate homepage. Lead asset gedatolisib in VIKTORIA-1 (P3 breast), VIKTORIA-2 (P3 breast), CELC-G-201 (prostate).

ctgov.note: Celcuity-sponsored trials: NCT05501886 (VIKTORIA-1, P3, ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING), NCT06757634 (VIKTORIA-2, P3, RECRUITING), NCT06190899 (CELC-G-201 mCRPC, P1/2, RECRUITING), NCT02684032 (P1, COMPLETED). Other listings are investigator-initiated where Celcuity is collaborator only.

pipeline.target: Pan-PI3K (class I alpha/beta/gamma/delta isoforms) and mTORC1/2 (PAM pathway)

indications.indication: HR+/HER2- advanced breast cancer, post-CDK4/6 + endocrine therapy (2L+)
indications.trial_design: Open-label, randomized P3 evaluating gedatolisib + palbociclib + fulvestrant vs gedatolisib + fulvestrant vs fulvestrant (PIK3CA WT cohort) and vs alpelisib + fulvestrant (PIK3CA MT cohort) in HR+/HER2- ABC after CDK4/6 inhibitor + endocrine therapy progression
indications.trial_status: ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING — primary PFS endpoint met in PIK3CA WT cohort; FDA Fast Track and Breakthrough Therapy designations granted; NDA initiated under Real-Time Oncology Review (Aug 2025)
key_milestones: Aug 2025: FDA accepted RTOR pre-submission for PIK3CA WT cohort

indications.trial_design: Open-label, randomized P3 evaluating gedatolisib + CDK4/6 inhibitor (palbociclib or ribociclib) + fulvestrant vs CDK4/6 inhibitor + fulvestrant in 1L HR+/HER2- ABC; cohorts split by PIK3CA WT vs MT status

indications.indication: Metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC), post-AR inhibitor
indications.trial_design: Phase 1b/2 evaluating gedatolisib in combination with darolutamide in mCRPC patients who progressed after AR inhibitor therapy; up to 54 participants
key_milestones: Jun 2025 / Sep 2025 (ESMO): Preliminary Phase 1b data reported

commercial_product.summary: CELsignia signaling activity diagnostic platform supports patient-selection biomarker work but is used primarily as a research / companion-diagnostic tool, not as a stand-alone marketed drug.

excluded_partner_owned.reason: Investigator-initiated; uses Celcuity CELx HSF diagnostic, not a Celcuity therapeutic.
